procedures.json.note: Derived from the audited bytes. Each of the 55 records has a per-record evidence section in a lane report.

kits.json.note: The audited bytes are recoverable and no kit has drifted materially, so this baseline is real. No kit has a per-record evidence section in any lane report, so it records integrity only, not screening.

rescue_cards.json.note: AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md records rescue-card SHA-256 4f8e47d0e93dcc95476f4e4bf8af0bcbfa866d6e5dca4fd63e54dd48fba2fc14 for the audited snapshot. Those bytes are in no object in this repository, reachable or unreachable, because the audit fingerprinted an uncommitted working tree. The audited baseline is therefore unrecoverable and is not reconstructed here: seeding it from current content would assert that today's text is what was screened. This baseline was established after the audit, catches drift from this point forward, and attests nothing about the audit.

amendments.rationale: Re-screened and accepted by the clinical owner. Post-audit change in 9425966 added topical tranexamic acid to equipment (500 mg/5 mL injectable solution on a pledget or soaking the pack, per local policy), the Zahed 2013 randomised trial supporting it, and matching search tags. No existing step, dose ceiling, contraindication or complication text was altered; the addition is an adjunct alongside the audited packing technique. The lane report's findings for this record stand.
amendments.followUp: docs/audits/procedure-verification/CLINICAL_OWNER_QUEUE.md#p2-resolve-scope-monitoring-and-failure-plans

amendments.rationale: The max-dose card was replaced by a weight-based calculator, and the per-record dosing copies were collapsed into one shared preparation table. This resolves findings the lane reports raised themselves: the 315-vs-300 mg lidocaine contradiction in 06_REGIONAL_UPPER and the 210-vs-200 mg ropivacaine contradiction in 08_REGIONAL_LOWER were both in workedExample, which no longer exists - the ceiling is computed and capped instead. The mg/kg and absolute values the audit screened are unchanged except for the addition of bupivacaine with epinephrine (3 mg/kg, 225 mg); lidocaine with epinephrine at 7 mg/kg / 500 mg was already in the corpus. No step, equipment, or technique text was touched.
amendments.followUp: The open STOP-SHIP and MAJOR dispositions on these records are untouched and still require adjudication - in particular 07_REGIONAL_TRUNK's objection that 2 mg/kg bupivacaine and 3 mg/kg / 200 mg ropivacaine are presented as universal ceilings when the labels require site- and patient-specific individualisation. Collapsing to one table makes that easier to act on, not resolved. Bupivacaine with epinephrine at 3 mg/kg / 225 mg is the conventional textbook figure and has not been screened against a primary source.
